name: caos-dispatchlab
description: DispatchLab — a didactic, in-browser bench that compares truck-to-shovel dispatch policies (greedy, shortest-wait, the two classic criteria, fixed, and two learned ONNX policies) on a deterministic discrete-event open-pit simulation. Policy-comparison sandbox, NOT a production dispatch system.

scripts.test: node --import tsx --test test/sim.test.ts test/topo.test.ts test/replay.test.ts test/hungarian.test.ts test/or.test.ts test/constraints.test.ts test/oracle.test.ts
